Re-attack the dominant n512 panel (shapes 3,7,9,10 = 33% of geomean) with a FUNDAMENTALLY DIFFERENT panel ALGORITHM, not more tuning of the existing panel-apply-fused (PAF) megakernel. Prior runs hill-climbed PAF's WY-representation to a local optimum; that local optimum is not a wall. Try a recursive/communication-avoiding QR (CAQR) or tournament TSQR factorization for the 512-tall panels: factor sub-panels independently and merge their R's via a reduction tree, which exposes more parallelism and shifts work onto tensor-core GEMMs. Implement as a new panel path; keep the old one as fallback. Validate HARD on all 12 shapes incl cond0; confirm geomean with interleaved A/B. NEVER use 'timeout' or any shell-timeout wrapper -- the harness auto-backgrounds long commands; run them directly.

n512 alt-panel-algo (CAQR/TSQR/recursive) investigation: rigorous NEGATIVE result, documented inline (behavior-neutral comment). ALGORITHMIC wall: checker needs flat geqrf Householder (sequential reflectors); CholeskyQR/TSQR/recursive panels emit incompatible reflectors (per-panel CholeskyQR2->geqrf-of-Q->flat fails factor residual even at B2 n32: 2.59 vs 0.0019); only a single global orhr_col on the full nxn Q converts validly, no per-panel shortcut. PERF wall at B640: FP64 chol(G)=6713us (hand-blocked bmm 6376, ALONE>PAF's 3.6ms total; FP64 mandatory at cond~1e5->Gram cond 1e10), TRSM=5813, FP64 Gram=4836, torch.geqrf batched=1.08s (300x), existing orhr_col B640=111ms. Device already saturated by 640 per-matrix-CTA PAF launches; multi-CTA m-split (only seq-HH-compatible parallelism lever) was tried+deleted by a prior worker. geomean 1938.9us == baseline (noise).

Brief-0 (n512 alt-panel-algo, CAQR/TSQR/recursive) -> rigorous NEGATIVE result, no speedup (geomean 1938.9us == baseline 1936.2us). The line is WALLED at B=640 on two independent axes, both measured not assumed:

(1) ALGORITHMIC: the checker scores Q=householder_product(H,tau), R=triu(H) -> it needs FLAT geqrf reflectors that compose SEQUENTIALLY. CholeskyQR/TSQR/recursive-CA panels emit reflectors INCOMPATIBLE with the global flat product (verified: per-panel CholeskyQR2->geqrf-of-Q->flat write-back fails the factor residual even at B2 n32, 2.59 vs allowed 0.0019). The ONLY valid conversion is a SINGLE global orhr_col on the full nxn explicit Q; no per-panel shortcut exists.

(2) PERFORMANCE: every batched primitive a CholeskyQR/TSQR pipeline needs is 1.6x-300x PAF's whole 3.6ms/call budget at B=640: FP64 chol(G)=6713us (cuSOLVER) and a hand-blocked bmm chol is NO better (6376us) -- FP64 GEMMs are the wall and chol ALONE exceeds PAF total; FP64 chol is MANDATORY (cond~1e5 -> Gram cond ~1e10, FP32 chol not PD). TRSM=5813us, FP64 Gram=4836us, _gram_int_ozaki=49ms, existing orhr_col B640=111ms, torch.geqrf batched=1.08s. The device is already saturated by 640 per-matrix-CTA PAF launches, so batched cuBLAS buys no parallelism the single-CTA path lacks. The only seq-Householder-compatible 'more parallelism' lever (multi-CTA m-split / row-block TSQR with a group-barrier merge) was implemented and DELETED by a prior worker for losing to PAF fusion.

The PAF megakernel (45% of shape3 GPU time, 76.7us avg/launch) is near-optimal for this algorithm family at B=640. Reviving the alt-line needs a FULL from-scratch batched-CTA-per-matrix kernel suite (3xTF32/Ozaki Gram, tensor-core blocked Cholesky, blocked right-TRSM, AND a batched orhr_col LU) -- each must beat ~0.7ms -- for a 2-3% best-case geomean dent on shape3, i.e. rebuilding most of PAF with worse numerics; also overlaps worker-0's CholeskyQR2 line.
